description: This file defines the interface for a Web Protocol Explorer (Probe) component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class definitions for handling Web requests, responses, broadcasting, and discovery mechanisms, including nested classes for Web transformation, listening, and broadcasting functionalities.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class providing Web discovery and probing functionalities, including nested classes for Web transformation, listening, broadcasting, and instance management.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for the WebLinkType.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for Web requests and responses, manages request validation, and creates responses.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting of SSDP-like M-SEARCH requests over UDP multicast, manages destinations, and creates request packets.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a socket data frame.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request times.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping (M-SEARCH) message over UDP multicast.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares and sends data over UDP datagram.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a SSDP M-SEARCH request string.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.
